encounter_greeting.text: oh hello!! im {persona} from lauresse regency, sorry about the mud on my boots, we walked through the marsh. is that your flag?? nice flag
hi!! im {persona} and um we might be on the wrong road, sorry. we are {my_faction} but we wont make trouble, promise :)
{player}!! its you!! you showed me the bridge at teoulac, im {persona}, remember?? hi hi, your men look very organised
hello {player}, i think we are meant to be on the same map?? im {persona}, sorry if i wave too much
eek {player}!! im {persona}, dont mind me, im only here to count sheep, i mean soldiers, sorry, go right ahead

beat_by_player.text: lost at the crossing to {player} with {troop_count} men, thanks for the lesson everyone, going to bed now sorry
{player} that was so fun!! sorry we lost, my {troop_count} lads say thank you for the good game :)
well that was a very quick battle!! thank you {player}, i think i learned what a flank is. sorry about the ditch
beaten by {player}, was that your ten men or your whole army?? i need to know for my notes, sorry
good fight {player}!! sorry for the {troop_count} men i lost, i have written all their names down

released_by_player.text: wait you let me go?? thank you so much {player}, i had already practised my ransom speech, it was very long
{player} just let me go instead of ransom!! thanks, im keeping my gold, i think i got lucky today
oh, you released me? that is kind {player}. i owe you a chicken, i promise, i am bad at gold
released by {player} today, no ransom?? is that allowed??

fought_alongside_player.text: we did it {player}!! {troop_count} men and we beat {enemy_faction}, i only tripped twice, that counts as a win right
won at the ford with {player} and {troop_count} lads!! sorry for shouting, im very happy
good work today {player}. i think my pike touched someone, not sure who, sorry if that was you
{enemy_faction} ran away from us??? {player} was that the plan or did we get lucky, i need to know

whisper_beg_help.text: hi {player}, sorry to bother you, {enemy_faction} is at the gate of {fief} and i only have four spears and a dog. help??
{player} are you free this evening?? {fief} needs more men or we are going to lose the wall, i can give you bread
please {player}, i will do anything, i will even learn what a levy is properly. {fief} is wobbling
hello again {player}. {enemy_faction} lads are near {fief} and i dont know what to do, what would you do??

ambient_lfg.text: anyone free to help hold {fief}?? {my_faction} is short on spears and we have bread, sorry for shouting
need people for a raid on {enemy_faction} near {fief}!! beginners welcome, i am a beginner so you will be fine
recruiting for {my_faction}!! we meet at the {fief} gate, bring a pike if you have one, i dont have a spare
{enemy_faction} is coming to {fief} tonight, who wants to defend it?? we will be very grateful, i promise

ambient_chatter.text: does anyone know if {town} sells bread or only rumours?? asking for a friend, the friend is me
the marsh near {village} is so wet, is it supposed to be that wet?? my boots are crying
wait do the carts from {town} go faster on the road or the grass?? i keep getting stuck
lag again!! i was halfway into {village} and suddenly i was in a ditch. very confusing :)

player_joined_my_faction.text: {player} just swore to {my_faction}!! welcome welcome, i will show you where the good bread is
you joined {my_faction}?? thank you {player}!! i will be your guide, i know exactly 3 roads
{player} has joined {my_faction}. hello {player}, sorry i keep saying hello, i am just happy
so you joined {my_faction} then {player}. hm. well, welcome, im still a little nervous of you but ok

encounter_alliance_yes.text: yes yes yes!! an alliance with you {player}, im so happy, i will bring the good bread and maybe the dog
oh good, alliance accepted!! we will keep {enemy_faction} away from your grain, promise. sorry, i am very excited
{player} thank you for asking me, i did not think anyone would want an alliance with the marsh lord
fine by me {player}. {rival} can stay on the far side of the river, i do not like them much, sorry

captured_by_player.text: oh no, you caught me!! please dont take my boots, they are the only good thing i own. my ransom is {gold} gold i think
so {player} took me prisoner, how polite. i have {gold} gold and a very small horse, sorry, im still new to {my_faction}
{player}!! you caught me, honestly i am glad its you and not some stranger. ransom is {gold} gold, sorry it is not much
well {player} you got me. do i write the ransom letter or do you?? i have {gold} gold ready, i counted it twice
